title: Content calendar
audience: For creators, marketers and founders who post every week.
description: A content calendar with an idea bank. Your AI turns ideas into scheduled posts and keeps the status current in Pinto Notes.
tagline: What goes out when, plus a bank of ideas.
note:
Content calendar

What's going out, where and when, plus a bank of ideas so you never start from a blank page.

## Voice
- Short sentences. One idea per post.
- Show the work: a screenshot or a number beats an adjective.
- End with a question, not a sales pitch.

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Content calendar". When I have an idea, add it under "Ideas" as a bullet with append_to_note. When I ask you to plan the next two weeks, pick ideas from "Ideas" and add a row per post with log_table_row: Publish on as a date, a working Title, the Channel and Status Drafting. Write drafts in the tone described under "Voice". When I say a post went out, set its Status to Published with edit_note.

asks: Idea: what we learned from 100 customer calls.
Plan the next two weeks: two LinkedIn posts and one newsletter.
